comments: Check the daily share totals and findings for three stock plans (#225, #235).
Plan A reserves 1,000 shares. Grant a-bad names a missing stakeholder. Grant a-good draws 300 shares for a known stakeholder.
Plan B reserves 100 shares. Grants b-1 and b-2 draw 80 and 30 shares, exceeding the reserve by 10.
Plan C reserves 500 shares. Grant c-1 draws 100 using TX_PLAN_SECURITY_ISSUANCE. Cancellation c-cancel names c-balance for the remaining 60 shares. Return c-return credits the 40 cancelled shares.
